rationale: All gold assertions are satisfied and traceable to logic_flow evidence. All 7 required CAPEC ids (CAPEC-57/94/114/115/593/633/650) are surfaced with correct EXPLOITS_WEAKNESS->CWE-287 linkage, and the narrative's abstraction-level grouping (Meta: CAPEC-94/114/115; Standard: CAPEC-593; Detailed: CAPEC-633/650/57) exactly matches each record's 'Abstraction' property in evidence. All 8 required ATT&CK techniques (T1040, T1134, T1185, T1505.003, T1548, T1550.001, T1557, T1563) are present, matching gold's min/max_records:8 exactly, and all 8 must_correlate cross-source joins are explicitly stated as 'correlation' claims. No invented ids, names, counts, or properties were found. Minor stylistic note: the narrative alone doesn't spell out every one of the 8 techniques/20 mitigations by name (it gives counts + a few examples), relying on the accompanying claims list for the full enumeration, which is why correctness is 0.97 rather than a full 1.0.
